The true discount (TD) is the interest on the true present worth (PW) for the given time and rate.

The sum due (P) is the sum of the true present worth (PW) and the true discount (TD).

$TD = \frac{P \times R \times T}{100} - \frac{TD \times R \times T}{100}$
